FROM ghcr.io/railwayapp/nixpacks:ubuntu-1745885067

ENTRYPOINT ["/bin/bash", "-l", "-c"]
WORKDIR /app/

COPY .nixpacks/nixpkgs-ffeebf0.nix .nixpacks/nixpkgs-ffeebf0.nix
RUN nix-env -if .nixpacks/nixpkgs-ffeebf0.nix && nix-collect-garbage -d

ARG CI NIXPACKS_METADATA NODE_ENV NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION
ENV CI=$CI NIXPACKS_METADATA=$NIXPACKS_METADATA NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=$NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION

COPY . /app/.
RUN --mount=type=cache,id=app-/root/npm,target=/root/.npm npm ci

COPY . /app/.
RUN --mount=type=cache,id=app-node_modules/cache,target=/app/node_modules/.cache npm run build

COPY . /app

CMD ["npm run start"]
